## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows `type: description` (`feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`, `ci`, `perf`, `build`, `revert`)
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] New behaviour and fixed bugs have a test
- [ ] A changeset describes the change (`pnpm changeset`), unless no package changes
- [ ] Breaking changes are called out and the changeset is `major`
